channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula e governo do RJ anunciam plano para retomar áreas sob domínio do crime
item.description: President Lula launched, in Rio de Janeiro, an integrated action plan with the state government aimed at retaking territories dominated by criminal organizations such as factions, militias, and the jogo do bicho.

item.title: Lula: experiência no RJ é um plano piloto, com as polícias trabalhando juntas para trazer paz
item.description: President Lula attended a ceremony in Rio de Janeiro to monitor integrated actions against organized crime. He emphasized that the experience in Rio is a pilot project with police forces working together to bring peace to the state.

item.title: Após crítica, Flávio diz que vai manter reajuste do Bolsa Família de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated he will keep the 15.04% increase in Bolsa Família if elected president, contradicting his earlier criticism of Lula's announcement. Despite initially calling the adjustment 'weak', Flávio pledged to maintain the social program.

item.title: Lula promete canetinhas no SUS mesmo após alerta de impacto de R$ 7 bilhões
item.description: President Lula promised to make weight-loss injections available through the SUS, disregarding government health committee warnings about a projected R$7 billion cost over five years.

item.title: Grass sai em defesa de Lula e sugere diálogo com FGC para salvar o BRB
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT) defended Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and criticized Governor Celina Leão regarding the BRB crisis, proposing dialogue with the Credit Guarantee Fund and the Central Bank to prevent privatization. He also presented proposals to reduce public health waiting times in the Federal District.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio evita confronto com Bolsa Família e mira debate fiscal
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign avoids direct confrontation over Lula's 15.04% raise in Bolsa Família, choosing instead to shift the debate toward efficient social program management and proposals for economic autonomy of beneficiaries, such as training and employment.

item.title: Lula diz não aceitar classificação de facções como terroristas: 'Terrorismo foi o 8 de Janeiro'
item.description: Lula rejected the US designation of PCC and CV as terrorists, claiming terrorism was January 8th and Bolsonaro's coup plotting. He stated that Trump and others confuse power struggles with state terrorism.

item.title: Contra ‘espuma’ do STF, Lula tem de falar do futuro e focar nos indecisos, diz José Genoino
item.description: José Genoino states that Lula should focus on the future and expose Flávio Bolsonaro's scandals to win undecided voters. He criticizes the Supreme Court crisis and advocates for justice reform, proposing term limits for ministers. The campaign should intensify social media and in-person outreach.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula diz que sempre foi contra GLO que ele decretou e prorrogou
item.description: Lula stated he has always opposed the GLO, which he himself decreed and extended in 2023, revealing a contradiction during an interview with Tupi radio. His stance faces criticism for inconsistency.

item.title: A interferência de Gilmar Mendes nas eleições em PE
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes has kept under investigation a case opened by the Pernambuco State Public Ministry that may affect the image of former mayor João Campos, a candidate for Pernambuco state government. The suspension of the investigation since February raises questions about potential judicial interference in the state elections.

item.title: Aumento do Bolsa Família: populismo fiscal com efeito eleitoral duvidoso
item.description: Columnist Fernando Schüler criticizes Lula's 15% Bolsa Família increase announced 17 days before elections, calling it fiscal populism without predictability. He highlights public debt growth from 71.7% to 82.5% of GDP and deficit above 9%, warning about the fiscal impact of the electoral measure.

item.title: Timing de operação contra Milton Leite pode ter poupado candidaturas dos filhos de contestação
item.description: The police operation against PCC in São Paulo, which includes former councilman Milton Leite as a fugitive, may have spared the electoral campaigns of his sons Alexandre Leite and Milton Leite Jr., who are running for seats in the São Paulo state legislature and the Chamber of Deputies under União Brasil.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro repete estratégia do pai e recruta ‘fiscais’ para eleições
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced the creation of a supporter network to monitor the 2026 elections, replicating the strategy used by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in 2022. The initiative includes a website for registrations and training for credentialed volunteers to oversee polling stations and prevent irregularities. Despite unproven allegations of electoral fraud, the action aims to mobilize supporters for election observation.

item.title: Defesa de Vorcaro pede revogação da prisão e cita impasse no STF
item.description: The defense of former banker Daniel Vorcaro requested the revocation of his preventive imprisonment, asking for substitution with precautionary measures such as house arrest and electronic ankle bracelet. Lawyers point to a stalemate over the case rapporteur at the STF, after Justice Alexandre de Moraes accused colleague André Mendonça of abuse of authority. The process remains stalled, with the defense arguing that the imprisonment cannot be indefinitely extended due to the institutional deadlock.

item.title: Lula foi alvo de 1 em cada 4 conteúdos com IA publicados na pré-campanha, diz levantamento
item.description: A survey by the Observatory AI in Elections revealed that President Lula (PT) was the main target of AI-generated content during the pre-campaign, with 112 cases of artificial reproduction of his image or voice. This accounts for approximately 25% of all AI-related content identified during the period.

item.title: Presidenciáveis prometem impulsionar setor elétrico sem priorizar transição energética
item.description: Presidential candidates are avoiding prioritizing energy transition in their campaigns, despite the pressure following the Ormuz crisis. Only Lula and Caiado mention decarbonization goals. Lula proposes domestic mineral processing and taxing raw mineral exports to strengthen national industry.

item.title: Bolsa Família reforça agenda de benefícios de Lula e retoma comparação com Bolsonaro em 2022
item.description: President Lula announced an increase in the Bolsa Família benefit from R$ 600 to R$ 691, strengthening his social agenda ahead of the 2026 elections. Unlike Bolsonaro in 2022, who used a constitutional amendment to expand benefits, Lula funds the increase through reallocated budget resources. The package also includes fuel subsidies worth an estimated R$ 5.8 billion in 2026.

item.title: Lula diz que 5 ministros do STF estão envolvidos com Master e avalia que crise respinga na eleição
item.description: Lula accuses five Supreme Court justices of involvement in the Banco Master scandal and warns the crisis could affect the 2026 election. He praises Moraes for his electoral role but criticises judicial deals with Banco Master.

item.title: Lula afirma que há 5 ministros do STF ligados ao caso Master
item.description: President Lula claimed that five Supreme Court justices are linked to the Banco Master case without naming them. He used the statement to advocate for judicial reform, accusing justices of indirect involvement and blaming the Bolsonaro administration. The case involves contracts by the wife of Justice Alexandre de Moraes and ties between Justice Dias Toffoli and individuals connected to Banco Master.

item.title: Lula cita orgias e afirma que muita gente teme vazamentos do Master
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview that there are fears of leaks regarding the Master case, alleging that former banker Daniel Vorcaro funded 'orgies' and corrupted authorities, including Supreme Court justices, deputies, and senators. According to Lula, Banco Master was created during Bolsonaro's administration and would involve a misappropriation of 60 billion reais with alleged fraudulent operations in securities. He advocates opening all secrets to investigate the case fully before enacting any judicial reform.

item.title: ‘Eles criaram um banqueiro e eu o tornei prisioneiro’, diz Lula sobre Vorcaro
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview with Rádio Tupi that the Bolsonaro family enabled Daniel Vorcaro, the former owner of Banco Master, to rise, and that he was arrested during his administration. Lula also linked the case to Flávio Bolsonaro and emphasized that the Banco Master investigations will be leveraged in the final stretch of the campaign.

item.title: Renan Santos pede que TSE suspenda reajuste do Bolsa Família assinado por Lula
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos (Mission) asked the TSE to suspend the 15% increase in Bolsa Família benefits granted by a decree signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Oito em dez brasileiros veem aumento da violência em dois anos, diz Quaest
item.description: A Pax/Quaest survey reveals that 79% of Brazilians believe violence has increased over the past two years, with 70% reporting a significant rise. The majority also think penalties for criminals are too lenient (67%). These findings underscore public security as a key issue in the 2026 elections.

item.title: O voo de galinha de Augusto Cury
item.description: Augusto Cury, a campaign phenomenon, is experiencing declining poll numbers and reduced digital traction, according to a subscriber-exclusive article.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula vai a evento sobre combate ao crime organizado
item.description: President Lula attends an event on combating organized crime in Rio de Janeiro alongside the interim governor Ricardo Couto. The focus is on integrated actions between federal, state, and public security forces to curb cargo thefts, trafficking, and money laundering. After the event, Lula heads to São Paulo for a campaign rally.

item.title: Pacote de Lula em ano eleitoral já mobiliza quase R$ 200 bilhões em bondades
item.description: President Lula's electoral package has already mobilized nearly R$200 billion, including the Bolsa Família adjustment and fuel price containment measures. These actions aim to secure popular support ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Vasco prepara 'troco' no Flamengo em clássico como mandante no Brasileiro caso não possa usar o Maracanã
item.description: Vasco prepares alternatives to replace Maracanã for the Flamengo derby in the Brazilian Championship if the consortium denies access. Options include São Januário and Manaus, disregarding previous agreements. The club also seeks judicial permission to use the stadium in other matches.

item.title: ONU se prepara para cúpula com clima, Ucrânia, Irã, Gaza e IA entre principais temas
item.description: The UN General Assembly in New York will address global crises such as the war in Ukraine, conflicts in the Middle East, and the risks of artificial intelligence. With around 150 leaders attending, including Netanyahu and Zelensky, the event marks the end of António Guterres's term, marked by criticism of the UN's inefficacy. Donald Trump will also participate, reinforcing his anti-multilateralism stance.

item.title: Quando é segundo turno das eleições 2026?
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections will take place in two rounds: the first on October 4th and the second, if necessary, on October 25th. The second round will only occur if no presidential or gubernatorial candidate reaches over 50% of valid votes. Five positions are at stake: state deputy, federal deputy, senator, governor, and president of the Republic.

item.title: Na reta final do 1º turno, Lula reforça agenda em SP para fortalecer Haddad
item.description: President Lula is intensifying his campaign in São Paulo to bolster Fernando Haddad's gubernatorial bid, with events in the capital and metropolitan areas. The strategy shifts focus from inland regions to São Paulo city after initial efforts, aiming to strengthen support in areas where PT won in 2022.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja as datas do primeiro e segundo turno
item.description: The 2026 elections in Brazil will take place in two rounds: the first on October 4th and the second, if necessary, on October 25th. Voters will elect state and federal deputies, senators, governors, and the president of the Republic. A second round is required if no presidential or gubernatorial candidate reaches over 50% of valid votes.

item.title: "Bobagem", diz Valdemar sobre aposta de que Flávio pode ganhar no 1º turno
item.description: The national president of the PL, Valdemar Costa Neto, said it is 'nonsense' to believe Flávio Bolsonaro could win the 2026 elections in the first round, stating that the second round is inevitable. However, he expressed confidence in Flávio's victory against Luiz Inácio Lula in the second round.

item.title: A interferência (cada vez mais explícita) dos EUA na eleição brasileira - O Assunto #1807
item.description: Podcast The Assunto #1807 discusses the increasing interference of the United States in the 2026 Brazilian election, focusing on Trump's explicit support for pro-Trump candidates. Guests include Oliver Stuenkel, who analyzes how Trump attempts to influence elections abroad and Lula's concerns about potential electoral irregularities. The content also covers Trump administration criticisms of Brazil's fight against PCC and Red Command, highlighting recent diplomatic tensions.

item.title: Reajustar Bolsa Família não passa de ardil eleitoreiro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced an increase in the Bolsa Família benefit from R$600 to R$691, with payments scheduled between the first and second electoral rounds. Critics view this as an electoral maneuver, as Lula previously condemned the use of social policies for campaign purposes during Jair Bolsonaro's re-election bid.

item.title: Entenda se o governo pode reajustar benefício social em ano eleitoral e diferenças de aumentos de Lula e Bolsonaro
item.description: The federal government announced a 15.04% adjustment to Bolsa Família, increasing the floor from R$ 600 to R$ 691 and the average benefit from R$ 675 to R$ 777, effective in October. Experts consider the adjustment legal but question the electoral timing, drawing criticism from opponents who call it electoral exploitation. Unlike the 2022 Kamicaze PEC, the current adjustment only corrects accumulated inflation without real gains.

item.title: Exame Nacional da Magistratura tem inscrições abertas de prova obrigatória para quem quer ser juiz
item.description: Registration for the National Judiciary Exam (ENAM) is open until September 24th. The exam, required to apply for judge positions, will take place on November 29th in all Brazilian capitals. The registration fee is R$120, with exemptions for low-income candidates and other specific criteria.

item.title: ‘É de direita ou esquerda?’: buscas sobre espectro político de candidatos disparam; especialistas analisam impacto
item.description: Google searches for 'left or right' regarding candidates nearly tripled since the start of the 2026 electoral campaign. Experts highlight that polarization is serving as an initial filter for voters, who seek to align beliefs before analyzing proposals. Ideological curiosity extends beyond the presidency to regional and local races.

item.title: Datafolha, 1º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, cor e religião
item.description: Datafolha poll for the 2026 first round shows Lula at 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 36%, within the margin of error. Augusto Cury takes third place with 6%, followed by Caiado, Renan, and Zema.

item.title: Aumento do Bolsa Família: quanto vou receber? Como medida chegou ao TSE? Veja perguntas e respostas
item.description: The federal government announced a 15% adjustment to the Bolsa Família minimum benefit on Thursday, raising it from R$600 to R$691, benefiting around 20 million families. The increase, also lifting the average benefit from R$675 to R$777, aims to compensate for the 17% loss in purchasing power due to inflation since 2023. The announcement, made 17 days before the first round of elections, led presidential candidate Renan Santos to file a lawsuit with the TSE requesting the suspension of the measure.

item.title: Campanha de Lula comemora estabilidade no Datafolha e Flávio aposta em crise no STF para avançar
item.description: Datafolha poll keeps Lula at 46% and Flávio at 44% in a second-round scenario, unchanged from last week, despite the Supreme Court crisis. Lula's campaign views stability as a win, while Flávio bets on the judicial turmoil to gain momentum.

item.title: Reajuste no Bolsa Família começa a ser pago em 19 de outubro, entre primeiro e segundo turno das eleições; veja calendário
item.description: Bolsa Família will receive a 15.04% adjustment starting October 19, raising the minimum benefit from R$600 to R$691, benefiting approximately 19 million families. The budgetary impact is estimated at R$5.8 billion in 2024 and R$22 billion in 2027 through reallocations.

item.title: Pax/Quaest: 70% dizem que violência “aumentou muito” em 2 anos
item.description: A Pax/Quaest survey released on September 18, 2026, reveals that 70% of Brazilians believe violence has increased significantly over the past two years, particularly among women (76%). Violence is seen as the main issue facing Brazil by 28% of respondents, followed by corruption (22%) and the economy (19%), while 60% support the use of artificial intelligence in public security.

item.title: Seis em cada dez brasileiros acreditam que limitar acesso a armas melhora a segurança, indica Quaest
item.description: Quaest survey reveals that 58% of Brazilians support restricting access to firearms, particularly among women (62%) and Blacks (67%). Public security is the top concern for 28% of respondents, surpassing corruption, economy and health.

item.title: Violência é a maior preocupação dos brasileiros, com corrupção em segundo lugar, aponta Quaest
item.description: Public security is the main concern among Brazilians (28%), followed by corruption (22%), according to a Quaest survey. The federal government has the worst evaluation in security matters, with 36% of negative self-assessment. Security technologies receive broad approval, while 58% of respondents oppose increasing armament.

item.title: A nova pesquisa presidencial no segundo maior colégio eleitoral do país
item.description: A new Quaest survey commissioned by TV Globo will analyze voting preferences in Minas Gerais, Brazil's second-largest electoral college, for the 2026 elections. The study covers presidential, gubernatorial, and senatorial races, with fieldwork from September 19 to 22 and results released on September 23, polling 1,506 voters with a 3-point margin of error.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lidera em 5 das 10 UFs com menor pobreza extrema
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads in 5 of the 10 states with the lowest extreme poverty rates, followed by Lula in 2 states and a technical tie in 3. Data released by IMDS reveals regional electoral disparities.

item.title: Agregador mostra distância de só 0,6 ponto entre Lula e Flávio no 2º turno
item.description: A new Datafolha poll aggregated by UOL shows the presidential race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round remains extremely tight, with only a 0.6 percentage point difference between the two candidates. The poll indicates stability in voter intention, keeping the first round close between the contenders.

item.title: Entre eleitores de Lula, 84% dizem estar totalmente decididos, aponta Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha polling shows that 84% of Lula voters and 82% of Flávio Bolsonaro voters have already made up their minds about their 2026 vote choice. The poll was released on Thursday, the 17th, indicating a highly defined electorate with 14 months to go before the elections.

item.title: 'Aparência de populismo': Caiado critica promessa de Lula sobre canetas emagrecedoras
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticizes Lula's promise to distribute weight-loss pens for free, calling it 'populist appearance'. The statements were made in an interview with Jornal da Record.

item.title: Lula refuta “dobradinha” com Aécio e defende voto casado na esquerda
item.description: Lula denied an alliance between left-wing candidates and Aécio Neves, reinforcing support for the married vote on the left during a walk in Montes Claros, MG. He emphasized positions on respect for women and announced free distribution of obesity medications through SUS, while demanding responsibility in the campaign.
